EXECUTED (source read, sts2_rl/relics/mummified_hand.py:22-33): `on_card_played` now builds `base_costing` from `costs_energy_before_modifiers()` (the CostModifiers.None tier) and tries four tiers -- `[base_costing filtered by costs_energy(hooks)], [hand filtered by costs_energy(hooks)], base_costing, hand` -- in order, taking the first non-empty one, matching MummifiedHand.cs:31-45's four `Rng.CombatCardSelection.NextItem` tiers over the two cost predicates (local vs `includeGlobalModifiers: true`). EXECUTED (`py -m pytest test/test_relic_live_tail.py -k mummified -q`): 5 passed, covering G1 (global-modifier cost read), G2 (the empty-tier-1 RNG-draw fallback) and G3 (per-CardPlay hook bracket, shared with combat.py's `play_index` loop). Nothing gap-classified remains under this hook.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the sim's candidate filter reads the card's LOCAL cost; C# reads the cost WITH GLOBAL MODIFIERS (CostsEnergyOrStars(includeGlobalModifiers: true))
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): Both halves shipped together, because they are one rewrite of the same four-tier pick. MummifiedHand.cs:32-45 builds `list` = hand cards whose PRINTED cost is > 0 (`EnergyCost.GetWithModifiers(CostModifiers.None)`) and then tries FOUR `Rng.CombatCardSelection.NextItem` tiers, each only if the previous returned null: list-that-costs-now, hand-that-costs-now, list, hand. relics/mummified_hand.py is now those four tiers in order, returning on the first non-empty one. (G1) The filter is `c.CostsEnergyOrStars(includeGlobalModifiers: true)` = `!CostsX && EnergyCost.GetWithModifiers(CostModifiers.All) > 0` (CardModel.cs:1578-1592) -- the cost the player would pay RIGHT NOW, GLOBAL modifiers included. The port read `c.energy_cost`, which is the LOCAL half alone (free-this-turn / cost-this-turn / cost-this-combat / per-turn delta); the global half is Hook.ModifyEnergyCostInCombat (CardEnergyCost.cs:116-119), dispatched by the sim as `modify_card_energy_cost` and never asked. Ported as `Card.costs_energy(hooks)` plus `Card.costs_energy_before_modifiers()` for the CostModifiers.None tier, so the two costs are named rather than conflated -- and potions.py was already using the `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost(c, c.energy_cost) > 0` idiom, so this is now consistent across the sim. EXECUTED: with CorruptionPower up (every Skill free) and a hand of [Defend, Defend, Bash], the relic now frees the BASH; it used to free a Defend. (G2) The fallbacks. The port returned early when tier 1 was empty, so with a hand of nothing but 0-cost cards it picked nothing and skipped the draw C# takes. `Rng.NextItem` on an EMPTY sequence takes no draw (Rng.cs:255-265), so the game consumes exactly ONE NextInt, from the first non-empty tier -- which is why the tiers are written out rather than collapsed. EXECUTED: a hand of [Dazed, Dazed] now takes exactly 1 card_selection draw and frees a card (it took 0 and freed none), while an EMPTY hand still takes 0 draws. The gameplay effect of G2 alone is nil -- every candidate already costs 0 -- but combat_rng.card_selection is the run-level COMBAT_CARD_SELECTION stream in parity mode, so the missing draw shifted every later card-selection roll for the rest of the run.  Pinned by test/test_relic_live_tail.py.  NOT CLOSED: the MIRROR direction this entry flags for another unit -- relic/spiked_gauntlets RAISES Power costs, so a base-0 Power reads as costing in C# and as free in the sim. `costs_energy` is now the helper that fixes it, but it is that record's site.  The text it replaced read: MECHANISM: MummifiedHand.cs:33 and :36 filter on `c.CostsEnergyOrStars(includeGlobalModifiers: true)`, which is `!EnergyCost.CostsX && EnergyCost.GetWithModifiers(CostModifiers.All) > 0` (CardModel.cs:1578-1592) -- the cost the player would actually pay right now, global modifiers included. mummified_hand.py:25 filters on `c.energy_cost`, which is the sim Card's own LOCAL cost (cards/base.py: free-this-turn, cost-this-turn, cost-this-combat and the per-turn delta) and nothing else; the sim's global cost modifiers live in the `modify_card_energy_cost` hook chain (hooks.py, consulted only at play time, combat.py) and the relic never asks it. So a card the player could already play for free still looks 'costing' to the sim and the free cost is spent on it. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes_b10.py mummified-hand): CorruptionPower (powers.py) makes every SKILL cost 0 globally and is applied by the ported Ironclad Rare Power card cards/corruption.py:35. With Corruption up and a hand of [Inflame, Defend x4, Bash] the sim still reports energy_cost>0 for all four Defends (the probe prints the hook pricing them at 0) and freed a DEFEND; C#'s tier 1 admits only Bash, so the game frees the Bash. Both sides ported: Mummified Hand is Rare in the transcribed grab bag (relic_pools.py, executed by this module's `pool` probe). The mirror direction exists too: relic/spiked_gauntlets (spiked_gauntlets.py:26-31) RAISES Power costs, so a base-0 Power reads as costing in C#'s tier 2 and as free in the sim. Rule 7: CardModel.cs, powers.py, cards/base.py, hooks.py, combat.py, cards/corruption.py, relics/spiked_gauntlets.py and relic_pools.py are NOT hashed by this record.

guards.what: G3 (LIVE): AfterCardPlayed fires once per Replay iteration in C# and once per play in the sim, so a DOUBLED Power card frees two cards in the game and one in the sim
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the hook bracket is per CardPlay now. CombatState._resolve_card_play opens `for play_index in range(play_count)` and fires `hooks.before_card_played` INSIDE it (sts2_rl/combat.py) and `hooks.on_card_played` at the end of each iteration, gated on the combat still being in progress (sts2_rl/combat.py) -- CardModel.cs:1904-1965's `for (int i = 0; i < playCount; i++)` with Hook.BeforeCardPlayed at :1929 and Hook.AfterCardPlayed at :1957-1959. A replayed card therefore fires both hooks once per iteration, as in the game. WAS: combat.py bracketed the WHOLE play-count loop, so a Throwing-Axe-doubled card fired each hook once.

guards.rationale: Structurally satisfied: on_card_played is a combat hook dispatched only by a live CombatState, and C#'s own AfterCardPlayed dispatch is itself gated on IsInProgress (CardModel.cs:1957), so the relic's copy of the check is redundant on both sides. Checked deliberately rather than assumed, because combat.py fires on_card_played BEFORE play_card's `_end_combat` call (combat.py), so a killing blow reaches this hook in the sim. It reaches it in C# too: audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json G13 enumerates all six CheckWinCondition sites and none is inside CardModel.Play, so IsInProgress is still true when the game fires the hook. Rule 7: CardModel.cs, combat.py and the turn_structure record are unhashed here.

Multiplayer ownership plumbing: the sim has exactly one player and one hand (self.player.hand), so both the owner test and the per-owner pile lookup are structurally satisfied. Noted in the mapping rather than treated as a divergence, per PROMPT.md's scope note on multiplayer-only params.

guards.what: N3: X-cost cards are excluded from C#'s first three tiers -- is the sim's single filter equivalent for them?
guards.rationale: EXECUTED (relic_probes_b10.py mummified-hand). C# bars X-cost cards from tiers 1 and 2 via `!EnergyCost.CostsX` (CardModel.cs:1582, :1586) and from tier 3 because `GetWithModifiers(CostModifiers.None)` is 0 for them, so only tier 4 can ever pick one. The sim's three ported X-cost cards -- cascade, volley, whirlwind -- all set `_energy_cost = 0` alongside `energy_cost_x = True` (cards/whirlwind.py:29, :33), so `c.energy_cost > 0` excludes them as well. The tier-4 asymmetry is G2's subject, not a separate defect. Rule 7: CardModel.cs and cards/whirlwind.py are unhashed here.
